title: Session 2: The little horn
opening_question: Among the ten horns of Daniel's fourth beast a little horn comes up with a mouth speaking great things. What does it do, how long, and what does Revelation 13 say about the beast's mouth?

steps.question: Where did the little horn come up, what fell before it, and what did it have?

facts.text: The little horn has "eyes like the eyes of man, and a mouth speaking great things".

steps.question: What did the horn do to the saints, and until when?

facts.text: "the same horn made war with the saints, and prevailed against them" until "judgment was given to the saints of the most High".

steps.question: What shall he speak, what shall he think to change, and for how long?

facts.text: The word for "time" in Daniel 7:25 is iddan: "a set time; technically a year".
Many read Paul's "man of sin" beside the little horn: he "opposeth and exalteth himself above all that is called God".

steps.question: What was given to the beast from the sea, for how long, and against whom does it make war?

facts.text: Daniel's horn has "a mouth speaking great things" and "made war with the saints". The beast of Revelation 13 is given "a mouth speaking great things" and power "to make war with the saints".

steps.question: What happens in the end to Daniel's beast, and to the beast of Revelation?

facts.text: Daniel's beast is "given to the burning flame"; John's beast is "cast alive into a lake of fire".

steps.question: Living it out: the horn "shall wear out the saints", yet judgment is given to them. What do these verses say to believers under pressure?

facts.text: "be thou faithful unto death, and I will give thee a crown of life"; "Blessed is the man that endureth temptation".

remember.text: The little horn has "a mouth speaking great things".
The same horn "made war with the saints".
"until a time and times and the dividing of time"
The beast is given power "forty and two months".
